scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && vitest run --maxWorkers=4 && npm run build
scripts.test:regression: npm run test:regression:api && npm run test:regression:masters && npm run test:regression:identity
scripts.test:regression:masters: vitest run tests/regression/masters-contract.test.ts tests/masters tests/projects tests/organisation tests/equipment-units tests/stock-levels tests/offer-letter tests/relationships tests/permissions tests/db/shared-uom.test.ts tests/testing-pass/conflicts-and-ownership.test.ts --maxWorkers=4
scripts.test:regression:identity: vitest run tests/regression/identity-contract.test.ts tests/auth tests/access tests/audit-log tests/testing-pass/auth-edges.test.ts tests/testing-pass/tenant-isolation.test.ts tests/testing-pass/idempotency-http.test.ts tests/core/password.test.ts tests/core/rate-limit.test.ts tests/hardening/shared-rate-limit.test.ts tests/hardening/cors.test.ts --maxWorkers=4
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests eslint.config.js tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests eslint.config.js tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json package.json
